principle_text: When the persuadee responds positively but without engagement in the donation topic, avoid only polite small talk without gradually introducing the charitable cause or purpose.
When the persuadee responds with neutral greetings, avoid continuing with generic small talk that does not advance the donation conversation or build persuasive momentum.
When the persuadee responds with polite but neutral acknowledgments, avoid only exchanging greetings without steering the conversation toward the charitable cause or donation request.
When the persuadee shows confusion or uncertainty about the request, avoid asking vague or unclear questions that may lead to misunderstandings about who should take action.
